data.name: Arigna Fuels
data.description: Arigna Fuels is a fifth-generation Irish family-run solid fuel manufacturer (part of Arigna Group) historically known for smokeless coal brands Ecobrite and Cosyglo. In 2023 they commissioned one of Europe's largest biochar plants in Co. Roscommon, using pyrolysis to produce biochar for agriculture, carbon sequestration, and as feedstock for their Harvest Flame renewable biomass heating product. Solid fuel remains a core business alongside the biochar activities.
